newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico private pensions seen with 8.0 mln members.
newsitem.headline: Mexico private pensions seen with 8.0 mln members.

text.p: Membership of Mexico's private pension funds is growing by up to 300,000 people a month and may number eight million when the first contributions arrive in September, the head of the country's third largest pension fund said on Wednesday.

"By September, when the funds receive their first contributions, we may have between seven and eight million affiliated workers," Humberto Allendes, head of the Santander-Mexicano pension fund, told a news conference on Wednesday.
"We (already) have 2.7 million members, which represents 27 percent of the total market," he said, adding between 200,000 and 300,000 workers were signing up each month.
By July, when Mexico's new pension system starts operating, he estimated about four million people would have joined.
Santander-Mexico is Mexico's third largest pension fund, with about 440,000 members so far.
The director of pension fund Bancomer said on Wednesday that his fund was in the lead, with 640,000 clients, whie Banamex was in second place with 550,000 members.
Mexico's new private pension system includes 17 funds which are looking to serve some 10.5 million workers enrolled in the Mexican Social Security Institute.
